tierNames.2: Tier II — Heroes of the Realm (Lv 5–10)
tierNames.3: Tier III — Masters of the Realm (Lv 11–16)
tierNames.4: Tier IV — Masters of the World (Lv 17–20)

combat.name: Combat
combat.tagline: Martial prowess, steel, endurance, and battlefield dominance.

devotion.name: Devotion
devotion.tagline: Sacred vows, divine channeling, healing, and protective auras.

magic.name: Magic
magic.tagline: Arcane weave, spellcraft, metamagic, and eldritch pacts.

social.name: Social
social.tagline: Persuasion, bardic inspiration, intrigue, and commanding presence.

exploring.name: Exploring
exploring.tagline: Scouting, stealth, wilderness mastery, and unmatched agility.

hybrid.name: Hybrid
hybrid.tagline: Cross-role disciplines forged by uniting two or more roots.

nodes.name: Combat
nodes.summary: Mastery of weapons, armor, endurance, and direct battlefield force.
nodes.mechanics: Unlocks the Combat branch. Grants proficiency with Simple Weapons and +1 to Initiative rolls.

nodes.name: Athletics
nodes.summary: Proficiency in climbing, jumping, swimming, grappling, and shoving.
nodes.mechanics: Gain proficiency in the Athletics skill. Advantage on checks to maintain a grapple once per short rest.

nodes.name: Strength Save
nodes.summary: Resist forced movement, restraints, and raw physical force.
nodes.mechanics: Gain proficiency in Strength saving throws.

nodes.name: Martial Arms
nodes.summary: Training with all martial melee and ranged weaponry.
nodes.mechanics: Gain proficiency with all Martial Weapons.

nodes.name: Soldier’s Grit (d8)
nodes.summary: Upgrade your base Hit Die from d6 to d8.
nodes.mechanics: Your Hit Die becomes at least d8 (retroactively increasing max HP by +1 per character level).

nodes.name: Battlefield Armor
nodes.summary: Wear Light Armor, Medium Armor, and wield Shields.
nodes.mechanics: Gain proficiency with Light Armor, Medium Armor, and Shields.

nodes.name: Rage
nodes.summary: Channel primal fury for bonus melee damage and damage resistance.
nodes.mechanics: Bonus action: enter Rage (2/LR, scaling with Tier). Gain advantage on STR checks/saves, +2 melee STR damage (+3 at T2, +4 at T3), and resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. Cannot cast/concentrate on spells.

nodes.name: Fighting Style
nodes.summary: Adopt a signature martial discipline.
nodes.mechanics: Choose one Fighting Style: Archery (+2 ranged attack), Defense (+1 AC in armor), Dueling (+2 one-handed damage), Great Weapon Fighting, Protection, or Two-Weapon Fighting.

choices.name: Archery
choices.description: You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with ranged weapons.

choices.name: Defense
choices.description: While you are wearing armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC.

choices.name: Dueling
choices.description: When wielding a melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with that weapon.

choices.name: Great Weapon Fighting
choices.description: When you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die for an attack made with a two-handed or versatile melee weapon, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.

choices.name: Protection
choices.description: When a creature you can see attacks a target other than you within 5 feet, you can use your reaction (with a shield) to impose disadvantage on the attack roll.

choices.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
choices.description: When you engage in two-weapon fighting, you can add your ability modifier to the damage of the second attack.

nodes.name: Second Wind
nodes.summary: Draw on stamina to recover HP mid-fight.
nodes.mechanics: Bonus action: regain 1d10 + character level HP. Recharges on a short or long rest.

nodes.name: Constitution Save
nodes.summary: Shrug off poison, frost, exhaustion, and concentration breaks.
nodes.mechanics: Gain proficiency in Constitution saving throws.

nodes.name: Reckless Attack
nodes.summary: Trade defense for devastating melee advantage plus Danger Sense.
nodes.mechanics: Gain advantage on melee STR attacks this turn (attacks against you have advantage until next turn). Also gain advantage on DEX saves against effects you can see.

nodes.name: Improved Critical
nodes.summary: Score critical hits on natural 19 or 20.
nodes.mechanics: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20. Also add half proficiency bonus to non-proficient STR/DEX/CON checks.

nodes.name: Extra Attack
nodes.summary: Attack twice whenever you take the Attack action.
nodes.mechanics: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

nodes.name: Combat Superiority
nodes.summary: Four d8 Superiority Dice and three tactical combat maneuvers.
nodes.mechanics: Learn 3 Battle Master maneuvers (e.g., Trip Attack, Riposte, Precision Attack, Menacing Attack) and gain 4d8 Superiority Dice (short rest recharge).

choices.name: Trip Attack
choices.description: Expend a superiority die on a weapon hit to add it to damage; Large or smaller target makes a STR save or is knocked prone.

choices.name: Riposte
choices.description: When a creature misses you with a melee attack, use your reaction and a superiority die to make a melee weapon attack adding the die to damage.

choices.name: Precision Attack
choices.description: Expend a superiority die to add it to a weapon attack roll before or after rolling, before knowing the outcome.

choices.name: Menacing Attack
choices.description: Expend a superiority die on a hit to add to damage; target makes a WIS save or is frightened of you until the end of your next turn.

choices.name: Parry
choices.description: When another creature damages you with a melee attack, use your reaction and a superiority die to reduce the damage by the roll + DEX modifier.

choices.name: Pushing Attack
choices.description: Expend a superiority die on a hit to add to damage; Large or smaller target makes a STR save or is pushed up to 15 feet away.

choices.name: Disarming Attack
choices.description: Expend a superiority die on a hit to add to damage; target makes a STR save or drops one object it is holding.

choices.name: Commander's Strike
choices.description: Forgo one attack and use a bonus action to direct an ally to immediately strike with their reaction, adding your superiority die to damage.

nodes.name: Action Surge
nodes.summary: Push beyond normal limits for an extra action.
nodes.mechanics: On your turn, take one additional action. Once per short or long rest (twice at Tier IV).

nodes.name: Martial Vigor (d10)
nodes.summary: Upgrade your Hit Die to d10.
nodes.mechanics: Your Hit Die becomes at least d10 (retroactively increasing max HP by +1 per level over d8).

nodes.name: Heavy Plate
nodes.summary: Don Heavy Armor and absorb incoming blows.
nodes.mechanics: Gain proficiency with Heavy Armor. While wearing heavy armor, nonmagical B/P/S damage is reduced by 2.

nodes.name: Power Strike Mastery
nodes.summary: Trade -5 accuracy for +10 weapon damage.
nodes.mechanics: Choose Heavy Melee (GWM: bonus attack on crit/kill, -5/+10) or Ranged (Sharpshooter: ignore cover/long range, -5/+10).

choices.name: Great Weapon Master
choices.description: On a melee crit or reducing a foe to 0 HP, make one melee attack as a bonus action. Before a heavy melee attack, take -5 to hit for +10 damage.

choices.name: Sharpshooter
choices.description: No disadvantage at long range; ignore half and three-quarters cover. Before a ranged weapon attack, take -5 to hit for +10 damage.

nodes.name: Sentinel
nodes.summary: Lock down foes and punish attacks against allies.
nodes.mechanics: Opportunity attacks reduce target speed to 0; provoke even on Disengage; reaction melee attack when a creature within 5 ft attacks an ally.

nodes.name: Brutal Critical
nodes.summary: Roll extra weapon damage dice on critical hits.
nodes.mechanics: Roll two additional weapon damage dice when determining extra damage for a critical hit with a melee attack. Gain Relentless Rage.

nodes.name: Indomitable
nodes.summary: Reroll a failed saving throw through sheer willpower.
nodes.mechanics: Reroll a failed saving throw (2/LR). You must use the new roll.

nodes.name: Juggernaut Vitality (d12)
nodes.summary: Upgrade your Hit Die to the maximum d12.
nodes.mechanics: Your Hit Die becomes d12 (retroactively increasing max HP by +1 per level over d10).

nodes.name: Apex Blade (3 Attacks)
nodes.summary: Unleash three weapon strikes with every Attack action.
nodes.mechanics: You can attack three times whenever you take the Attack action. Your Superiority Dice become d10s if you possess Combat Superiority.

nodes.name: Primal Champion
nodes.summary: Transcend mortal limits with +4 STR and +4 CON.
nodes.mechanics: Your Strength and Constitution scores increase by 4, and your maximum for those scores is now 24.

nodes.name: Devotion
nodes.summary: Sacred vows, divine channeling, restoration, and radiant protection.
nodes.mechanics: Unlocks the Devotion branch. Grants proficiency with a Holy Symbol focus and the Guidance or Spare the Dying cantrip.

choices.name: Guidance
choices.description: Learn the Guidance cantrip (add 1d4 to one ability check).

choices.name: Spare the Dying
choices.description: Learn the Spare the Dying cantrip (stabilize a creature at 0 HP by touch).

choices.name: Thaumaturgy
choices.description: Learn the Thaumaturgy cantrip (manifest minor signs of sacred wonder).

nodes.name: Templar Vestments
nodes.summary: Armor and shield proficiency consecrated for sacred service.
nodes.mechanics: Gain proficiency with Light Armor, Medium Armor, and Shields. You may emblazon your shield as a Holy Symbol.

nodes.name: Religion
nodes.summary: Lore of deities, rites, planes, and sacred orders.
nodes.mechanics: Gain proficiency in the Religion skill.

nodes.name: Tempered Vessel (d8)
nodes.summary: Fortify your body through devotion, upgrading Hit Die to d8.
nodes.mechanics: Your Hit Die becomes at least d8.

nodes.name: Medicine
nodes.summary: Stabilize the dying, diagnose afflictions, and tend wounds.
nodes.mechanics: Gain proficiency in the Medicine skill.

nodes.name: Wisdom Save
nodes.summary: Steadfast mind against charm, fear, and domination.
nodes.mechanics: Gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws.

nodes.name: Insight
nodes.summary: Discern true intent, falsehoods, and hidden motives.
nodes.mechanics: Gain proficiency in the Insight skill.

nodes.name: Channel Divinity
nodes.summary: Invoke divine energy to Turn Undead or fuel domain/oath powers.
nodes.mechanics: Gain Channel Divinity (1/SR, 2/SR at Tier II). Includes Turn Undead (WIS save, 30 ft) and unlocks Domain/Oath channel options.

nodes.name: Divine Sense & Health
nodes.summary: Detect celestials, fiends, and undead; immune to disease.
nodes.mechanics: Detect celestials/fiends/undead within 60 ft (1 + CHA mod/LR). You are immune to disease.

nodes.name: Lay on Hands
nodes.summary: A touch-healing pool of 5 × character level HP.
nodes.mechanics: Healing pool equal to 5 × character level (long rest). Spend HP to heal by touch, or spend 5 HP to cure one disease or neutralize one poison.

nodes.name: Warding Flare
nodes.summary: Blind attackers with radiant light and unleash Radiance of the Dawn.
nodes.mechanics: Reaction (WIS mod/LR): impose disadvantage on an attacker within 30 ft. Channel Divinity: dispel darkness and deal 2d10 + level radiant damage in 30 ft (CON half).

nodes.name: Aura of Protection
nodes.summary: Add your CHA or WIS modifier to all saving throws for you and nearby allies.
nodes.mechanics: While conscious, you and friendly creatures within 10 ft (30 ft at Tier IV) gain a bonus to all saving throws equal to your CHA or WIS modifier (min +1).

nodes.name: Disciple of Life
nodes.summary: Supercharge healing spells and Channel Divinity Preserve Life.
nodes.mechanics: Healing spells restore an extra 2 + spell level HP. Channel Divinity: restore up to 5 × level HP divided among creatures within 30 ft (up to half max HP).

nodes.name: Sanctuary of Will
nodes.summary: Advantage on death saves and emergency field triage.
nodes.mechanics: Use a Healer’s Kit as an action to restore 1d6 + 4 + target HD HP (1/SR per creature). Gain advantage on death saving throws and +1 WIS or CHA.

nodes.name: Destroy Undead
nodes.summary: Annihilate low-CR undead outright and add radiant power to strikes/cantrips.
nodes.mechanics: Undead of CR 2 or lower (CR 4 at Tier IV) failing Turn Undead are instantly destroyed. Once per turn, add +1d8 radiant damage to a weapon hit or cantrip.

nodes.name: Aura of Warding
nodes.source5e: Oath of the Ancients 7 / Cleansing Touch 14
nodes.summary: Grant resistance to all spell damage inside your aura.
nodes.mechanics: You and friendly creatures within your Aura of Protection have resistance to damage from spells. Action: end one spell on yourself or a willing touched creature (CHA/WIS mod/LR).

nodes.name: Divine Intervention
nodes.summary: Call directly upon your deity to reshape reality.
nodes.mechanics: Implore your deity for aid (automatic success at Level 20, or roll ≤ character level on d100). Replicates any Cleric spell or miracle of equal potency.

nodes.name: Supreme Radiance
nodes.summary: Maximize all healing dice and radiate a 30-ft Holy Nimbus.
nodes.mechanics: Maximize all dice rolled to restore HP with spells. Once per long rest, emanate sunlight for 1 minute dealing 10 radiant damage to enemies starting their turn within 30 ft.

nodes.name: Magic
nodes.summary: Shape the arcane weave, command cantrips, and unlock spell slots.
nodes.mechanics: Unlocks the Magic branch. Choose INT, WIS, or CHA as your primary spellcasting ability. Learn 2 cantrips and gain Arcane Focus proficiency.

choices.name: Arcane Study (INT)
choices.description: Use Intelligence as your primary Fivefold 5e spellcasting ability.

choices.name: Primal Intuition (WIS)
choices.description: Use Wisdom as your primary Fivefold 5e spellcasting ability.

choices.name: Innate Weave (CHA)
choices.description: Use Charisma as your primary Fivefold 5e spellcasting ability.

nodes.name: Intelligence Save
nodes.summary: Defend your mind against psionics, illusions, and feeblemind.
nodes.mechanics: Gain proficiency in Intelligence saving throws.

nodes.name: Arcana
nodes.summary: Knowledge of spells, magic items, eldritch symbols, and planes.
nodes.mechanics: Gain proficiency in the Arcana skill.

nodes.name: Spellcasting I
nodes.summary: Unlock 1st- and 2nd-level spell slots (up to 4/3 slots).
nodes.mechanics: Gain 1st-level spell slots (and 2nd-level at Lv 3), +1 cantrip, and prepare/know spells equal to casting mod + proficiency bonus.

nodes.name: History
nodes.summary: Recall ancient empires, legendary artifacts, and lost lineages.
nodes.mechanics: Gain proficiency in the History skill.

nodes.name: Arcane Craft
nodes.summary: Brew potions and scribe spell scrolls.
nodes.mechanics: Gain proficiency with Alchemist’s Supplies and Calligrapher’s Supplies. Halve time and gold cost to scribe scrolls.

nodes.name: Ritual Casting
nodes.summary: Cast ritual spells without expending spell slots.
nodes.mechanics: Maintain a ritual grimoire. Cast any spell you know with the ritual tag by adding 10 minutes without spending a slot.

nodes.name: Arcane Recovery
nodes.summary: Recover expended spell slots during a short rest.
nodes.mechanics: Once per day on a short rest, recover spell slots with combined levels ≤ ceil(character level / 2) (none 6th or higher).

nodes.name: Metamagic
nodes.summary: Twist spells with Sorcery Points (Quickened, Twinned, Subtle).
nodes.mechanics: Gain Sorcery Points equal to character level (or 3 + Tier×2) and 2 Metamagic options (Quickened, Twinned, Subtle, Careful, Distant, Empowered).

choices.name: Quickened Spell
choices.description: Spend 2 Sorcery Points to change a spell casting time from 1 action to 1 bonus action.

choices.name: Twinned Spell
choices.description: Spend Sorcery Points equal to spell level (1 for cantrip) to target a second creature with a single-target spell.

choices.name: Subtle Spell
choices.description: Spend 1 Sorcery Point to cast a spell without any somatic or verbal components.

choices.name: Careful Spell
choices.description: Spend 1 Sorcery Point to let up to CHA/casting mod allies automatically succeed on saves against your spell.

choices.name: Distant Spell
choices.description: Spend 1 Sorcery Point to double a spell range (or turn Touch range into 30 feet).

choices.name: Empowered Spell
choices.description: Spend 1 Sorcery Point to reroll up to your casting modifier damage dice for a spell.

nodes.name: Eldritch Invocations
nodes.summary: Always-on eldritch augmentations and cantrip empowerment.
nodes.mechanics: Learn 2 Eldritch Invocations (e.g., Agonizing Blast, Devil’s Sight, Mask of Many Faces, Repelling Blast); learn +1 additional invocation per Tier.

choices.name: Agonizing Blast
choices.description: Add your spellcasting modifier to the damage you deal on a hit with Eldritch Blast or a signature cantrip.

choices.name: Devil's Sight
choices.description: See normally in darkness, both magical and nonmagical, to a distance of 120 feet.

choices.name: Mask of Many Faces
choices.description: Cast Disguise Self at will without expending a spell slot.

choices.name: Repelling Blast
choices.description: When you hit a creature with your eldritch beam, push it up to 10 feet away from you in a straight line.

choices.name: Armor of Shadows
choices.description: Cast Mage Armor on yourself at will without expending a spell slot or material components.

choices.name: Eldritch Mind
choices.description: Gain advantage on Constitution saving throws made to maintain concentration on a spell.

choices.name: Eldritch Spear
choices.description: Increase the range of your Eldritch Blast / signature ranged cantrip to 300 feet.

choices.name: Eyes of the Rune Keeper
choices.description: You can read all writing in any language.

nodes.name: Arcane Ward
nodes.summary: Project a rechargeable magical shield that absorbs damage.
nodes.mechanics: Create an Arcane Ward with HP = 2 × level + casting mod. Recharge it when casting abjuration spells; at Tier III, project it to shield allies within 30 ft.

nodes.name: Sculpt Spells
nodes.summary: Carve safe pockets in area blasts to spare your allies.
nodes.mechanics: Choose 1 + spell level allies when casting an AoE evocation spell; they automatically succeed on their save and take 0 damage.

nodes.name: Spellcasting II
nodes.summary: Unlock 3rd-, 4th-, and 5th-level spell slots.
nodes.mechanics: Unlock 3rd-level slots (4th at Lv 7, 5th at Lv 9), +1 cantrip, and access to iconic mid-tier spells (Fireball, Counterspell, Haste, Fly, Wall of Force).

nodes.name: Pact Boon
nodes.summary: Claim a Pact of the Tome, Chain familiar, or summoned Pact Blade.
nodes.mechanics: Choose Pact of the Chain (upgraded familiar), Pact of the Tome (+3 cantrips from any list), or Pact of the Blade (summonable magical weapon using casting stat).

choices.name: Pact of the Blade
choices.description: Summon a magical pact weapon as an action (or bond an existing magic weapon); you are always proficient with it.

choices.name: Pact of the Chain
choices.description: Learn Find Familiar and summon an enhanced familiar (imp, pseudodragon, quasit, or sprite) that can attack using your reaction.

choices.name: Pact of the Tome
choices.description: Receive a Book of Shadows containing three cantrips of your choice from any spell list.

nodes.name: War Caster
nodes.summary: Advantage on Concentration saves and opportunity-attack spells.
nodes.mechanics: Advantage on CON saves to maintain concentration; perform somatic components with hands full; cast a single-target spell as an opportunity attack.

nodes.name: Elemental Adept
nodes.summary: Pierce elemental resistance and double ranged spell reach.
nodes.mechanics: Spells of your chosen element ignore resistance and treat 1s on damage dice as 2s. Double range on attack-roll spells and ignore half/three-quarters cover.

choices.name: Acid
choices.description: Acid spells ignore resistance to acid damage and treat 1s on damage dice as 2s.

choices.name: Cold
choices.description: Cold spells ignore resistance to cold damage and treat 1s on damage dice as 2s.

choices.name: Fire
choices.description: Fire spells ignore resistance to fire damage and treat 1s on damage dice as 2s.

choices.name: Lightning
choices.description: Lightning spells ignore resistance to lightning damage and treat 1s on damage dice as 2s.

choices.name: Thunder
choices.description: Thunder spells ignore resistance to thunder damage and treat 1s on damage dice as 2s.

nodes.name: Spellcasting III
nodes.summary: Unlock 6th- and 7th-level spell slots.
nodes.mechanics: Unlock 6th-level slots (7th at Lv 13) and high-magic incantations (Disintegrate, Chain Lightning, Forcecage, Teleport).

nodes.name: Bend Luck & Chaos
nodes.summary: Manipulate d20 rolls with Sorcery Points and master arcane flux.
nodes.mechanics: Reaction (2 Sorcery Points): add or subtract 1d4 from another creature’s attack roll, ability check, or saving throw. Gain +1 Metamagic option.

nodes.name: Spell Mastery
nodes.summary: Cast a chosen 1st- and 2nd-level spell at will without slots.
nodes.mechanics: Choose one 1st-level and one 2nd-level spell you know. Cast them at their lowest level at will without expending spell slots.

nodes.name: Archmage (Spellcasting IV)
nodes.summary: Command 8th- and 9th-level world-shaping magic (Wish, Meteor Swarm).
nodes.mechanics: Unlock 8th-level slots (9th at Lv 17) and ascend to true Archmage mastery.

nodes.name: Social
nodes.summary: Diplomacy, performance, leadership, deception, and inspiring allies.
nodes.mechanics: Unlocks the Social branch. Learn 1 extra Language and gain proficiency with 1 Musical Instrument or Gaming Set.

nodes.name: Performance
nodes.summary: Captivate audiences through music, oratory, or theater.
nodes.mechanics: Gain proficiency in the Performance skill.

nodes.name: Charisma Save
nodes.summary: Anchor your sense of self against banishment and possession.
nodes.mechanics: Gain proficiency in Charisma saving throws.

nodes.name: Persuasion
nodes.summary: Win allies, broker treaties, and sway hearts in good faith.
nodes.mechanics: Gain proficiency in the Persuasion skill.

nodes.name: Deception
nodes.summary: Spin convincing bluffs, fast-talk guards, and conceal truths.
nodes.mechanics: Gain proficiency in the Deception skill.

nodes.name: Intimidation
nodes.summary: Project menace, command obedience, and shatter enemy morale.
nodes.mechanics: Gain proficiency in the Intimidation skill.

nodes.name: Bardic Inspiration
nodes.summary: Grant allies bonus inspiration dice (d6 → d12) on key rolls.
nodes.mechanics: Bonus action (CHA mod/LR; SR at Tier II): grant an ally within 60 ft an Inspiration die (d6 at T1, d8 at T2, d10 at T3, d12 at T4) to add to an ability check, attack roll, or save.

nodes.name: Jack of All Trades
nodes.summary: Add half proficiency to all non-proficient checks & Song of Rest.
nodes.mechanics: Add half your proficiency bonus (rounded down) to any ability check you make that doesn’t already include your proficiency bonus (including Initiative). Allies regain +1d6 HP on short rests.

nodes.name: Persona & Forgery
nodes.summary: Master Disguise Kits and Forgery Kits.
nodes.mechanics: Gain proficiency with Disguise Kits and Forgery Kits, plus one established false identity.

nodes.name: Cutting Words
nodes.summary: Subtract Inspiration dice from enemy attacks, checks, or damage.
nodes.mechanics: Reaction: spend a Bardic Inspiration die to subtract its roll from a visible creature’s attack roll, ability check, or damage roll within 60 ft. Inspiration now recharges on a short rest.

nodes.name: Countercharm
nodes.summary: Rally allies with advantage against frightened and charmed effects.
nodes.mechanics: Action (or Bonus Action once/SR): for 1 round, allies within 30 ft have advantage on saves against being frightened or charmed, and may immediately retry one failed save.

nodes.name: Inspiring Leader
nodes.summary: Deliver a 10-minute speech granting Level + CHA Temp HP to the party.
nodes.mechanics: Up to 6 friendly creatures who hear your 10-minute address gain temporary HP equal to your character level + CHA modifier (1/SR per creature).

nodes.name: Silver Tongue
nodes.summary: Treat d20 rolls of 9 or lower as 10 on Persuasion and Deception.
nodes.mechanics: Whenever you make a Persuasion or Deception check, treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.

nodes.name: Master Mimic (Actor)
nodes.summary: Imitate voices flawlessly and gain advantage while disguised.
nodes.mechanics: Gain +1 CHA, advantage on Deception and Performance checks when passing yourself off as another person, and mimic any speech or sound heard for 1 minute.

nodes.name: Peerless Skill
nodes.summary: Inspire your own ability checks and taunt or charm foes with pure panache.
nodes.mechanics: Roll a Bardic Inspiration die and add it to your own ability check. Action: make a Persuasion check contested by Insight to impose disadvantage on a hostile foe attacking anyone else, or charm a non-hostile target for 1 minute.

nodes.name: Commanding Presence
nodes.summary: Turn fear and authority into decisive battlefield orders.
nodes.mechanics: Bonus action (CHA mod/LR): issue a command allowing an ally within 60 ft to immediately use their reaction to move half speed or make one weapon attack; or force a foe within 30 ft to make a WIS save or become frightened for 1 minute.

nodes.name: Sovereign Voice
nodes.summary: Never start a fight without Inspiration and speak to all minds.
nodes.mechanics: Roll initiative with 0 Inspiration dice to immediately regain 2 dice. All creatures with INT 4+ understand your speech; once per long rest, issue a Sovereign Decree granting all allies within 60 ft advantage on attacks and saves for 1 round.

nodes.name: Exploring
nodes.summary: Stealth, scouting, traps, survival, mobility, and sharp senses.
nodes.mechanics: Unlocks the Exploring branch. Gain +5 ft walking speed and proficiency with Explorer’s Pack navigation.

nodes.name: Investigation
nodes.summary: Uncover traps, secret doors, clues, and logical deductions.
nodes.mechanics: Gain proficiency in the Investigation skill.

nodes.name: Perception
nodes.summary: Spot ambushes, hidden creatures, and faint details.
nodes.mechanics: Gain proficiency in the Perception skill.

nodes.name: Survival
nodes.summary: Track quarry, forage food, predict storms, and guide expeditions.
nodes.mechanics: Gain proficiency in the Survival skill.

nodes.name: Nature
nodes.summary: Know beasts, flora, weather, and primal ecosystems.
nodes.mechanics: Gain proficiency in the Nature skill.

nodes.name: Dexterity Save
nodes.summary: Dodge fireballs, falling rubble, and dragon breath.
nodes.mechanics: Gain proficiency in Dexterity saving throws.

nodes.name: Stealth
nodes.summary: Move unseen and unheard through shadows and wilderness.
nodes.mechanics: Gain proficiency in the Stealth skill.

nodes.name: Thieves' Tools
nodes.summary: Pick locks, disable traps, and bypass security mechanisms.
nodes.mechanics: Gain proficiency with Thieves’ Tools and learn Thieves’ Cant.

nodes.name: Expertise
nodes.summary: Double your proficiency bonus on two chosen skills or tools.
nodes.mechanics: Choose two of your skill proficiencies (or one skill and Thieves’ Tools). Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check using them.

choices.name: Acrobatics
choices.description: Double your proficiency bonus on Acrobatics checks.

choices.name: Animal Handling
choices.description: Double your proficiency bonus on Animal Handling checks.

choices.name: Arcana
choices.description: Double your proficiency bonus on Arcana checks.

choices.name: Athletics
choices.description: Double your proficiency bonus on Athletics checks.

choices.name: Deception
choices.description: Double your proficiency bonus on Deception checks.

choices.name: History
choices.description: Double your proficiency bonus on History checks.

choices.name: Insight
choices.description: Double your proficiency bonus on Insight checks.

choices.name: Intimidation
choices.description: Double your proficiency bonus on Intimidation checks.

choices.name: Investigation
choices.description: Double your proficiency bonus on Investigation checks.

choices.name: Medicine
choices.description: Double your proficiency bonus on Medicine checks.

choices.name: Nature
choices.description: Double your proficiency bonus on Nature checks.

choices.name: Perception
choices.description: Double your proficiency bonus on Perception checks.

choices.name: Performance
choices.description: Double your proficiency bonus on Performance checks.

choices.name: Persuasion
choices.description: Double your proficiency bonus on Persuasion checks.

choices.name: Religion
choices.description: Double your proficiency bonus on Religion checks.

choices.name: Sleight of Hand
choices.description: Double your proficiency bonus on Sleight of Hand checks.

choices.name: Stealth
choices.description: Double your proficiency bonus on Stealth checks.

choices.name: Survival
choices.description: Double your proficiency bonus on Survival checks.

choices.name: Thieves' Tools
choices.description: Double your proficiency bonus on Thieves' Tools checks.

nodes.name: Hardened Scout (d8)
nodes.summary: Build trail-forged resilience, upgrading your Hit Die to d8.
nodes.mechanics: Your Hit Die becomes at least d8.

nodes.name: Herbalism & Maps
nodes.summary: Craft healing potions and chart unknown regions.
nodes.mechanics: Gain proficiency with Herbalism Kits and Cartographer’s Tools.

nodes.name: Animal Handling
nodes.summary: Calm mounts, read beasts, and bond with wild companions.
nodes.mechanics: Gain proficiency in the Animal Handling skill.

nodes.name: Acrobatics
nodes.summary: Tumble, balance on narrow ledges, and escape grapples.
nodes.mechanics: Gain proficiency in the Acrobatics skill.

nodes.name: Sleight of Hand
nodes.summary: Legerdemain, pickpocketing, and concealing small objects.
nodes.mechanics: Gain proficiency in the Sleight of Hand skill.

nodes.name: Skirmisher Gear
nodes.summary: Light Armor plus rapiers, shortswords, hand crossbows, and shortbows.
nodes.mechanics: Gain proficiency with Light Armor, Shortswords, Rapiers, Hand Crossbows, and Shortbows.

nodes.name: Alert & Mobile
nodes.summary: +5 Initiative, cannot be surprised, and +10 ft movement speed.
nodes.mechanics: Gain +5 bonus to Initiative, you can’t be surprised while conscious, and your walking speed increases by +10 ft.

nodes.name: Natural Explorer
nodes.summary: Ignore nonmagical difficult terrain and master overland travel.
nodes.mechanics: Moving through nonmagical difficult terrain costs no extra movement. Gain climbing and swimming speed equal to walking speed, plus double foraging and tracking mastery.

nodes.name: Cunning Action
nodes.summary: Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a bonus action every turn.
nodes.mechanics: On each of your turns in combat, you can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

nodes.name: Evasion & Uncanny Dodge
nodes.summary: Halve attack damage with a reaction and take 0 damage on passed DEX saves.
nodes.mechanics: Reaction: halve damage of an attack that hits you from an attacker you can see. On DEX saves for half damage, take 0 damage on success and half on failure.

nodes.name: Reliable Talent
nodes.summary: Never roll below 10 on any proficient ability check.
nodes.mechanics: Whenever you make an ability check that lets you add your proficiency bonus, treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.

nodes.name: Vanish & Feral Senses
nodes.summary: Sense invisible foes within 30 ft and leave no trail.
nodes.mechanics: You can’t be tracked by nonmagical means unless you choose to leave a trail. Gain 10-ft Blindsight and never suffer disadvantage attacking invisible creatures you can hear.

nodes.name: Stroke of Luck
nodes.summary: Turn a missed attack into a hit or a failed check into a natural 20.
nodes.mechanics: Once per short or long rest, turn a missed weapon attack into a hit, OR treat a failed ability check as if you rolled a 20 on the d20.

nodes.name: Divine Smite
nodes.summary: Channel sacred wrath into melee hits for explosive radiant damage.
nodes.mechanics: When you hit with a melee weapon attack, expend a spell slot or Channel Divinity charge to deal +2d8 radiant damage (+1d8 per slot level above 1st; +1d8 vs undead/fiends).

nodes.name: Sacred Avenger
nodes.summary: Every melee strike deals +1d8 radiant damage and glows with holy accuracy.
nodes.mechanics: All melee weapon hits deal an extra 1d8 radiant damage (Improved Divine Smite). Channel Divinity: add CHA/WIS modifier to weapon attack rolls for 1 minute.

nodes.name: Divine Soul
nodes.summary: Unite divine and arcane spell lists and bend fate once per short rest.
nodes.mechanics: You may learn/prepare both Cleric and Arcane spells using your spellcasting slots. Once per short rest, add 2d4 to a failed saving throw or missed attack roll.

nodes.name: Celestial Conduit
nodes.summary: Empower radiant/healing spells and summon spectral wings of light.
nodes.mechanics: Add your casting modifier to one damage roll of any radiant or fire spell. Gain a 30-ft flying speed for 1 minute once per short rest.

nodes.name: Magical Secrets
nodes.summary: Poach two spells from any tradition and weave subtle enchantments.
nodes.mechanics: Learn 2 spells of any class list that you have slots to cast. Impose disadvantage on a target’s save against your enchantment or illusion spell once per short rest.

nodes.name: Split Enchantment
nodes.summary: Twin single-target enchantment spells automatically for free.
nodes.mechanics: When you cast a single-target enchantment spell of 1st level or higher, you may target a second creature in range at no extra cost.

nodes.name: Master of Intrigue
nodes.summary: Use the Help action at 30 ft as a bonus action and read social tells.
nodes.mechanics: Use the Help action as a bonus action; when aiding an ally’s attack, the target can be within 30 ft. Spend 1 minute observing a creature to learn two of its relative stats.

nodes.name: Spymaster’s Web
nodes.summary: Redirect attacks onto nearby foes and shield your thoughts from magic.
nodes.mechanics: Reaction: when targeted by an attack while a creature within 5 ft gives you cover, force the attack to target that creature instead. Thoughts cannot be read telepathically.

nodes.name: Sneak Attack
nodes.summary: Deal precision bonus dice (+1d6 to +6d6) with finesse or ranged weapons.
nodes.mechanics: Once per turn, deal extra precision damage with a finesse or ranged weapon when you have advantage or an ally is within 5 ft of target: 2d6 at T1, 4d6 at T2, 6d6 at T3, 8d6 at T4.

nodes.name: Martial Arts & Ki
nodes.summary: Unarmored Defense, DEX unarmed strikes, and Ki Flurry of Blows.
nodes.mechanics: While unarmored, AC = 10 + DEX + WIS, unarmed strikes use DEX and d6 (d8 at T2, d10 at T3) + bonus unarmed strike. Gain Ki points (SR recharge) for Flurry of Blows & Patient Defense.

nodes.name: Assassinate & Hunter
nodes.summary: Auto-crit surprised foes and add +1d8 Colossus Slayer damage.
nodes.mechanics: Advantage on attacks against creatures that haven’t acted yet; any hit against a surprised creature is a critical hit. Once per turn, deal +1d8 damage to an injured foe.

nodes.name: Stunning Strike
nodes.summary: Spend 1 Ki on melee hit to Stun enemies (CON save).
nodes.mechanics: When you hit with a melee attack, spend 1 Ki to force a CON save or Stun the target until the end of your next turn. Also spend 1 Ki to reroll a failed saving throw.

nodes.name: War Magic (Spellblade)
nodes.summary: Weave steel and spells: cast a cantrip and strike as a bonus action.
nodes.mechanics: When you use your action to cast a cantrip, make one weapon attack as a bonus action. Bond up to two weapons (cannot be disarmed; summon as bonus action).

nodes.name: Wild Shape
nodes.source5e: Druid 2 / Circle of the Moon (Exploring + Magic)
nodes.summary: Transform into beasts as a bonus action (2/SR) with Primal spell access.
nodes.mechanics: Bonus action (2/SR): transform into a beast up to CR 1 (CR = floor(level/3) at Tier III). Gain access to Druid primal spells through your spellcasting slots.

presets.name: Lv 5 Oathbound Paladin
presets.description: Combat + Devotion vanguard wielding Divine Smite, Heavy Armor, and Lay on Hands.

presets.name: Lv 5 Eldritch Spellblade
presets.description: Combat + Magic gish blending Fighting Style, Arcane Ward, and War Magic.

presets.name: Lv 5 Shadow Assassin
presets.description: Exploring + Combat skirmisher with Sneak Attack, Cunning Action, Expertise, and Assassinate.

presets.name: Lv 5 Lore Bard
presets.description: Social + Magic maestro combining Bardic Inspiration, Cutting Words, and Magical Secrets.
